workItem: Correlate the 28 currently relevant roadmap documents and implement a repository-wide single-source model where each canonical project roadmap owns organizational project execution status while bounded technical authorities, domain detail roadmaps and historical evidence remain preserved.
workItemDE: Die 28 aktuell relevanten Roadmap-Dokumente korrelieren und ein repositoryweites Single-Source-Modell umsetzen: je kanonischem Projekt genau eine organisatorische Projektstatus-Roadmap; technische Authorities, Fachdetails und historische Evidence bleiben erhalten.
releaseCondition: Release after the consolidation PR is merged, closed, superseded or abandoned.
releaseReason: PR #680 merged and satisfied the consolidation claim. The original broad claimed-path list is historical only and must not continue to block project writers.
